title: Nativity — Set 01
description: First presépio: the Holy Family, the shepherds, the Magi, the animals, and the stable. One set is one scale and one style — its figures must stand together.

scale.note: Set the standing-adult height before modelling anything; every other figure is proportioned from it. Traditional presépio scales run 70-200 mm for a home crib. Kneeling and infant figures are sized relative to this, not printed to it.

notes: Record per piece if origins differ across the set.
